_doc: Sidecar for Learn mode. Maps a notebook cell index to a circuit the canvas can draw. Cells without an entry fall back to parsing literal qc.<gate>() lines.

13.title: H₂ · Hartree-Fock + UCCSD
13.note: Qiskit Nature orders JW qubits [α0, α1, β0, β1]. For H₂ (1α + 1β electron) Hartree-Fock sets qubit 0 and qubit 2 to |1⟩. UCCSD(θ) is drawn as a block: it is not simulated here.

17.title: H₂ · Hartree-Fock baseline
17.note: The HartreeFock circuit used for the baseline energy: just two X gates.
